scenes.setting: A dark alley off the Damir Harbor seafront, minutes after Klein fled Flying Fish & Wine: the gold coin picks his turn, he calls out the tail — a black-cloaked man of about thirty who pitches him a pirate crew's creed, annual leave and treasure hunts (Sunken Laurel, Roselle's Treasure), then introduces himself as Rear Admiral Iceberg's fourth boatswain, Blazing Danitz; Klein's killing intent through Creeping Hunger makes him tremble and answer where White Shark lives
scenes.text_anchor: “Rear Admiral Iceberg Edwina Edwards’s subordinate, fourth boatswain of the Golden Dream, Blazing Danitz.”

scenes.setting: Klein gone: Danitz straightens up in the alley, takes off his cloak — 'What a terrifying fellow' — and resolves to telegraph his Captain in the morning about a new terrifying person at sea; White Shark's fate is not his concern

Another quiet street: Klein examines the black glove — Creeping Hunger's sealed hunger stirred when he wanted to kill Danitz — divines that Danitz did not lie and that White Shark cannot harm him, then reshapes his face into a blond, blue-eyed stranger, untucks his shirt and heads back to the bar
scenes.text_anchor: He instantly changed his appearance—blond hair, blue eyes, and ordinary facial features!

scenes.setting: On the way back to Flying Fish & Wine the disguised Klein passes Blazing Danitz, who glances once without recognizing him and heads for the hotel opposite; Klein checks the bounty wall and pushes the bar door open less than ten minutes after escaping
scenes.text_anchor: On the way, he met Blazing Danitz again.

scenes.setting: Inside the bar: the bandaged bartender stands beside his boss — a tall, fat, bald, fair-skinned man like a white shark come ashore — who is pressing Captain Elland about 'his passenger'; Elland pats his sword, answers with a proverb about wild dogs and rats, and White Shark Hamilton settles for half the damages before slapping the bartender's teeth out while the blond stranger watches from five metres away
scenes.text_anchor: “… Just Elland, is this your answer?” White Shark Hamilton narrowed his eyes.
